highlights.title: Hunt Underway After Deadly Shooting at Swiss Rave
highlights.summary: One reveler was killed and five were injured early Sunday at a dance party at a horseracing track in Switzerland’s north.

highlights.title: Split payment entre empresas deve ser obrigatório só em 2028
highlights.summary: Informação é da Secretaria da Receita Federal, que fala em complexidade de integração de mais de 200 instituições financeiras

highlights.title: Manhunt after shooting at Swiss rave kills woman, 22, and injures five
highlights.summary: Five others in their twenties were injured after shots were fired at a techno event near Zurich.

highlights.title: Iceland Votes to Steer Clear of European Union Talks
highlights.summary: After a divisive debate, Icelanders rejected a proposal to resume negotiations on joining the bloc. The referendum drew the highest voter turnout in almost two decades.

highlights.title: NASA launches $4.3bn Roman Telescope to uncover universe’s hidden secrets
highlights.summary: SpaceX Falcon Heavy propels telescope on cosmic quest to investigate dark energy and matter.

highlights.title: Os milhões de argentinos com dívidas em atraso e o que isso indica sobre a economia do país: 'Não tentamos mais refinanciar porque é impagável'
highlights.summary: Um a cada três habitantes da Argentina enfrenta problemas para liquidar dívidas contraídas junto a bancos, carteiras digitais e agiotas.
